title: Oracle OIC & Fusion WMS Techno-Functional Developer
teaser: We are looking for a highly skilled Techno-Functional Developer to bridge technical infrastructure and business operations, focusing on Oracle Fusion WMS and OIC integration. You will design robust integration patterns and support data flow across Oracle systems. Ideal for candidates with extensive experience in supply chain technology and Oracle Cloud solutions.
description:
The application window is expected to close on: 08/24/2026
Job posting may be removed earlier if the position is filled or if a sufficient number of applications are received.

Meet the Team 

Cisco IT is a transformation engine enabling people to do the best work of their lives! Our vision is to be loved as the world’s best IT organization. We lead with user experience, accept agile ways of working, drive engineering efficiency, and deliver with Cloud first, shift left, AI powered technology.

The Component Operations Supply Chain IT team is at the forefront of transforming our supply chain through technology. We specialize in implementing and optimizing our Supply Chain ERP solution, a critical backbone for managing everything from procurement to delivery. Our expertise ensures seamless integration of processes, providing real-time visibility and control over our entire supply chain operations. We empower data-driven decisions that enhance efficiency, reduce costs, and improve overall operational agility. 

Your Impact

We are seeking a 7+ years of highly skilled Techno-Functional developer to join our team. This role serves as a critical bridge between our technical infrastructure and business operations, specifically focusing on the integration and optimization of Oracle Fusion Cloud Warehouse Management System (WMS) and Oracle Integration Cloud (OIC). The ideal candidate will possess deep expertise in orchestrating complex supply chain workflows, building intuitive user interfaces, and ensuring the seamless flow of data across our Oracle ecosystem. You will be responsible for designing robust integration patterns, maintaining system stability, and leveraging the latest Oracle technologies to enhance our warehouse operations.

Integration Development: Build and implement end-to-end integration patterns using Oracle Integration Cloud, including App-driven and Scheduled integrations.

Orchestration & Logic: Create orchestration flows using switch conditions, loops, and standard fault-handling frameworks.

Adapter Usage: Configure and manage various OIC adapters, such as REST, SOAP, ERP Cloud, File, FTP, Stage File, and DB adapters.

Data Processing: Support data transfers and integration patterns, ensuring reliability and accuracy across systems.

Custom Development: Develop and maintain user-facing interfaces and extensions using Visual Builder Cloud Service (VBCS) in alignment with Redwood UI design principles.

Reporting & Database: Write PL/SQL scripts and BI Publisher (BIP) reports to support data extraction and business intelligence needs.

Functional Collaboration: Work with functional teams to understand SCM (Manufacturing and Fulfilment) requirements and assist in their technical implementation.

System Support: Assist with the maintenance of integration libraries and lookup management to ensure data integrity across Oracle Cloud Fusion SaaS and external systems.

Troubleshooting: Perform routine troubleshooting, utilize XPath expressions for data mapping, and follow established performance and security best practices.

Minimum Qualifications

7+ years of industry experience.

Core OIC Proficiency: Hands-on experience with REST integrations, fault handlers, and basic orchestration patterns

WMS Functional: Inbound, outbound, putaway, pick wave, LPN, serial/lot, cycle count

Technical: Proficiency in PL/SQL, XML/JSON parsing, and XPath expressions, PL/SQL, SQL, Oracle REST APIs, FBDI 

VBCS & UI: Experience building applications using VBCS and an interest in Oracle Redwood UI design principles

Oracle SaaS Knowledge: Familiarity with Oracle Cloud Fusion SaaS tables, UI navigation, and standard integration points

Reporting: OTBI, BI Publisher for WMS operational reports

Domain Knowledge: Functional understanding of Oracle SCM, particularly within Manufacturing and Fulfilment modules, and interest in Oracle WMS Cloud.

Problem Solving: Ability to troubleshoot integration issues and contribute to the development of reusable components.

Communication: Effective analytical skills with the ability to communicate technical tasks clearly to team members. 

Preferred Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field.

Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI) certification or OIC-specific professional certifications.

Experience working in a manufacturing or supply chain environment.

Familiarity with Agile delivery methodologies and project management tools. 

Why Cisco?

We’ve been innovating fearlessly for 40 years to create solutions that power how humans and technology work together across the physical and digital worlds. We are Cisco, and our power starts with you.
